name: Harvesting the Harvesters

angles.text: As a gnome, Ozwin's ambition to tinker with complex machinery is familiar. He misjudged the machines' aggression and ended up cornered in a farm stable.
As an engineer, you can salvage isosprings and gyrostabilizers from rogue harvest golems and use them as raw parts for an escape device.
As an Alliance traveler at Saldean's Farm, you can help a visiting gnome scholar stranded after his attempt to fix Westfall's rogue harvesters went wrong.

faq.answer: Ozwin Ironsprocket is a gnome tinkerer from Ironforge who came to Westfall to recalibrate the rampaging harvest golems. Their hostility drove him into a stable at Saldean's Farm.
The harvest golems in Westfall's abandoned fields are wildly aggressive toward passersby. Their ferocity far exceeds what Ozwin expected when he thought routine recalibration would fix them.
faq.q: Why are the harvest golems so aggressive?

aliases: where to turn in harvesting the harvesters
faq.answer: Ozwin Ironsprocket is hiding in a stable at Saldean's Farm in Westfall, sheltering from harvest golems in the nearby fields.
faq.q: Where can Ozwin Ironsprocket be found?

aliases: what does ozwin need parts for
faq.answer: Ozwin needs golem isosprings and harvester gyrostabilizers to build a mechanical contraption that will let him flee the stable safely.
faq.q: What does Ozwin intend to build with the collected parts?

aliases: why did ozwin come to westfall
faq.answer: Ozwin traveled from Ironforge to Westfall after hearing that rogue machinery was terrorizing the countryside. He believed he could recalibrate the harvesters.
faq.q: Why did Ozwin travel from Ironforge to Westfall?

aliases: how to get isosprings and gyrostabilizers
faq.answer: The isosprings and gyrostabilizers come from the hostile harvest golems and harvesters in the fields around Saldean's Farm in Westfall.
faq.q: Where do the required golem parts come from?

sections.body: Ozwin Ironsprocket came south from Ironforge when its workshops heard of haywire harvesters in Westfall. The gnomish engineer believed he could diagnose and recalibrate the farm machines. He hoped to bring peace to the region's farmlands, already troubled by outlaws and now overrun by rampaging harvesters.
sections.title: A Miscalculated Endeavor

sections.body: Near Saldean's Farm, Ozwin found the harvest golems far more violent than his schematics suggested. Their sharp blades and erratic swings drove him into a nearby stable. Trapped there, he cannot safely return to the fields. He needs daring travelers to salvage isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the machines so he can build a device to escape.
sections.title: Pinned in the Stable

summary: At Saldean's Farm in Westfall, Ozwin Ironsprocket is trapped by haywire harvest golems. The visiting gnome tinkerer needs salvaged parts to build a way out.
attribution: In-game quest text: Harvesting the Harvesters
